mutations.name: fr6-import-guard-dropped
mutations._mechanism: FR-6: replacing the guarded policy import with a bare import must break the missing-policy fail-closed JSON decision.
mutations.find:
_POLICY_IMPORT_ERROR = None
try:
    scripts = str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "scripts")
    if scripts not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, scripts)
    from h_mad_target_identity import (
        SIMPLE_SHELL_COMMAND,
        READ_ONLY_COMMANDS,
        SAFE_DISPATCH_VERBS,
        SAFE_HMAD_SCRIPT_OPTIONS,
        TEMP_OUTPUT_OPTIONS,
        SHELL_ALLOW_FILE,
        TRUSTED_BIN_DIRS,
        MALFORMED_WORKDIR,
        _contained_venv_executable,
        _cwd_escapes_root,
        _load_judge,
        _option_value,
        _path_within,
        _payload_cwd_base,
        _safe_argv,
        _safe_hmad_script,
        _safe_shell_command,
        _trusted_executable,
        _shell_allowance,
        _operator_allowed,
        _is_shell_allowance,
        _read_regular_text,
        _state_status,
        _any_phase5_status,
        _is_production_python,
    )

    _POLICY_IMPORT_ERROR = exc
